brief:
Gaza's health ministry reported Monday that five people were killed and 18 wounded arrived at hospitals over the preceding 48 hours, according to Shehab Wire. The fatalities comprised two newly killed persons and three bodies recovered from rubble during the period.

The ministry issued its routine daily casualty report without specifying the circumstances of the deaths or the conditions of those injured. Hospitals across the Gaza Strip have continued receiving casualties as violence persists in the territory.
